calls.title: Growthbook <> BidOne - Demo/Pricing Sync
calls.summary: The discussion centered on Growthbook's experimentation and feature flag platform, highlighting its ability to leverage Snowflake data warehouses for flexible metric creation and experimentation setups. The platform allows product managers to create metrics and dashboards quickly without requiring engineer assistance. It also includes detailed user targeting for feature flags using custom attributes, supporting multi-condition logic for precise scoping. The architecture emphasizes multi-tenant data isolation, with a recommendation for separate organizations per tenant. Managed warehouse options and self-hosting through Snowflake were discussed regarding data ingestion and event logging capabilities. Finally, the commercial model, trial setups, and ongoing support frameworks were outlined.
calls.keywords: feature flags, experimentation, multi-tenant architecture, data warehouse, SDK integration, pricing model

calls.title: Growthbook <> Bidone - Trial Scoping/Pricing Sync
calls.summary: The team discussed a three-week trial to test Growthbook's feature flagging and experimentation capabilities, emphasizing minimal AB testing and integration workflows as success criteria. Kalyan Ramaiah Asari confirmed the trial duration is adequate, while Dan Wathne outlined onboarding steps. A multi-tenant architecture is to be supported with environment and site separation, confirmed by Nevin Ma and Logan Bates. Pricing concerns arose as the proposed Enterprise license costs $50,000 annually plus $1,000 per user seat, which Kalyan highlighted as expensive compared to competitors like Posthog. Growthbook's positioning as a premium option with superior enterprise features was reiterated, along with a commitment to revisit pricing strategies. Future updates on managed warehouse options are expected by week’s end to accommodate budget expectations.
calls.keywords: multi-tenancy, trial setup, pricing discussion, self-hosted solution, enterprise license, infrastructure cost
